## 🚀 Featured Applied AI & Learning Projects
- **Project #1: Support Task Dashboard Project (Automated Email Intelligence & Work Tracking):**
  - **Overview:** End-to-end automated email ingestion and task tracking system running entirely via Docker on local machine only for 100% data privacy and security. Cron background scheduler monitors specific support mailboxes, local Ollama running Llama models with LangGraph extracts tasks and developer activities from unstructured emails without sending any sensitive data to external clouds, persists structured records into local PostgreSQL, displays real-time metrics on an interactive web portal, and exports graphical charts, CSV, and formatted/pivoted Excel files for daily team worksheet submissions.
  - **Tech Stack:** Docker (Local Machine Only), Python, Ollama, Llama Model, LangGraph, PostgreSQL, IMAP/Cron Automation, Pandas/OpenPyXL.
  - **Live Video Demo Available:** `Mail_Read_Every_Set_cron_using_ollama_llama_postgressql.mp4` on portfolio site.
  - **Executive Presentation Deck Available:** `RSOS_AI_Task_Automation_Executive_Presentation.pptx` downloadable directly from portfolio.

- **Project #2: Mukesh Ajmera — AI-Powered Financial Advisory & Insurance Intelligence Platform:**
  - **Overview:** Full-stack Python application with relational database persistence, intelligent conversational AI assistant (LIC MITRA) with voice input, 20+ schemes catalog, comparison engine, SheetJS Excel export, and live Vercel cloud deployment.
  - **URL:** https://aimukeshajmera.vercel.app/

- **Project #3: RSOS Dual-Stream & On-Demand Enterprise Portal — Major Tech Stack Modernization:**
  - **Overview:** Architected and executed statewide modernization for Rajasthan State Open School (RSOS) serving 100,000+ candidates. Upgraded legacy PHP 8.2.10 to PHP 8.5.9, migrated Laravel 8 to Laravel 13.39.0, and upgraded the database to MariaDB 12.3.3-MariaDB across 342 normalized relational tables with 0.34ms connection latency on Microsoft-IIS/10.0 FastCGI. Delivered utilizing Human & Agentic Development (collaborative AI agents for automated refactoring, unit testing, and schema verification under senior human architectural oversight).
  - **Enterprise Office Works Note:** In multiple enterprise office projects, real client/department names are protected under NDA & government security compliance. All architectures delivered via Human & Agentic Development.
  - **Live Production Telemetry Snapshot:** Verified and displayed on portfolio site (`system_tech_stack_architecture_upgrade.png`).

- **Project #4: E-Court & High Court Secure Inter-Agency API Integration:**
  - **Overview:** Mission-critical API integration gateway linking State Department portals with High Court and E-Court judicial systems using AES payload encryption and automated token lifecycle management.

- **Project #5: Enterprise Grievance & Collaborative Task Platform (GrievancePortal):**
  - **Overview:** Full-stack enterprise governance system architected with .NET Core, Angular, Bootstrap, and SQL Server. Enforces strict zero-trust stored procedure security with multi-factor mobile OTP authentication, n-level client grievance lifecycle tracking, collaborative daily task boards, real-time in-house team chat with dynamic '#' cross-linking, organization topology trees, and granular user activity audit logs—built via Google DeepMind Antigravity Agentic AI workflows.
  - **Tech Stack:** .NET Core Web API (C#), Angular (SPA), Bootstrap 5, SQL Server (Strict Stored Procedures), SignalR / WebSockets, Mobile OTP SMS Gateways, Antigravity AI SDLC.
  - **Zero-Trust Database Security:** 100% strict parameterized stored procedures. Application database credentials have zero direct table DDL/DML permissions, eliminating SQL injection.
  - **Innovative '#' Cross-Linking Lexer:** Custom in-app autocomplete parser allowing staff to tag and cross-reference grievances (#GRV), daily tasks (#TSK), and project nodes directly from chats and notes in real time.
  - **Enterprise Office Works Note:** Client & department identifiers anonymized under institutional NDA. Engineered via Human & Agentic Development with Antigravity AI workflows.
  - **Architecture Topology Snapshot:** Displayed on portfolio (`enterprise_grievance_portal_architecture.png`).
